summary: Defines the Single Rate Three Color Marker, a meter used in Diffserv traffic conditioners. It measures a packet stream against a committed rate and burst allowances, then marks each packet green, yellow or red to show how well it conforms. Routers can then treat the colors differently. This is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: Think of a traffic light for data. Each packet gets a green, yellow or red sticker depending on whether it fits the allowed speed, so busy roads can decide who goes first.
